content.thinking: ASan fails due to environment issue "reading executable name failed" / proc maps — likely restricted environment (the local trial lacks /proc? or ASan can't map). This is environment, not our code. The task says private evaluator in local trial doesn't run ASan. So fine. But we want to ensure no UB. UBSan alone maybe works. Try -fsanitize=undefined only.

arguments.command:
cd /work/submit && g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all planb64.cpp -o /tmp/planb_ubsan 2>&1 | tail
python3 - <<'PY'
s=open('/tmp/fuzz.py').read().replace("BIN='/work/submit/planb64'","BIN='/tmp/planb_ubsan'").replace('range(300)','range(120)')
open('/tmp/fuzz_ub.py','w').write(s)
PY
python3 /tmp/fuzz_ub.py
# error cases under ubsan
sed 's#BIN=./work/submit/planb64.#BIN="/tmp/planb_ubsan"#' /tmp/err.py > /tmp/err_ub.py
python3 /tmp/err_ub.py
